minutes.headline: Planning Board reorganized with Brenner as chair and tabled the first-refusal decision on a Leominster Road parcel.
minutes.summary: The board elected its officers and filled committee assignments by voice vote, with Mr Wilson taking the new Master Plan Steering Committee seat. It then heard a first-refusal notice on parcel 4 Leominster Road and tabled it until the Open Space committee gives its recommendation. The rest was master plan kickoff updates, a grant for design work at the Leominster-Shirley Road intersections, committee reports, flood map updates and approval of the 5/22 minutes.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board tabled the first-refusal decision on a Leominster Road parcel until the Open Space committee gives its recommendation.
The board elected Matt Brenner chair, Matthew Allison vice chair and Amanda Reed clerk, each by unanimous voice vote.
Committee seats were filled by voice vote, including Mr Wilson on the new Master Plan Steering Committee.
The town applied for a no-match grant for design work at the Leominster-Shirley Road intersections.
A public kickoff for the master plan was set for Thursday at 7 PM, and steering committee members were asked to bring guests.

why_it_matters: The tabled parcel is Chapter 61 land, so the town has a limited window to appraise and buy it, and the delay moves that decision to the next meeting.
The master plan kickoff and the intersection design grant touch future land use and traffic along the Leominster-Shirley Road corridor, and residents can attend the kickoff.
watch_next: Open Space committee meeting on Wednesday the 14th, whose recommendation the board is waiting for on the parcel.
Master plan public kickoff on Thursday at 7 PM in the meeting room.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on all twelve votes, including the ayes and the outcomes. The differences are caption misspellings of two members' names (Reed for Reid, Wilson for Willsmer), items only one record has, and who held the chair and vice chair before the reorganization. A reader should check that last point: our minutes call Brenner the outgoing chair, while the official minutes list Allison as Chair and Brenner as Vice Chair.
